title: Structural coherence of three derived images and open extensions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X\xrightarrow{l}U\xrightarrow{a}V\xrightarrow{b}\overline X$ be three open immersions of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion], and let $\overline X\xrightarrow{p}\overline Y\xrightarrow{s}\overline Z\xrightarrow{t}T$ be arbitrary scheme morphisms. Work in the unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $O_j=D(j_!)$, $P_f=R(f_*)$, and $\epsilon(j,k):O_{j\gg k}\to O_j\mathbin{\star}O_k$ for the canonical derived open-extension expansion [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition], where $F\star G$ means first $F$, then $G$. Write $\kappa(f,g):P_f\star P_g\to P_{f\gg g}$ for the specified derived direct-image contraction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition], defined as the mate of exact-derived inverse-image composition. For every $K\in D(X,A)$, the following loop on $P_tP_sP_pO_bO_aO_lK$ is the identity: contract $P_tP_s$ using $\kappa(s,t)$; contract $O_bO_a$ using $\epsilon(a,b)^{-1}$ under $P_{s\gg t}P_p$; contract $P_{s\gg t}P_p$ using $\kappa(p,s\gg t)$; contract $O_{a\gg b}O_l$ using $\epsilon(l,a\gg b)^{-1}$ under $P_{p\gg(s\gg t)}$; transport along associativity of the two scheme composites; expand $P_{(p\gg s)\gg t}$ to $P_tP_{p\gg s}$ and then to $P_tP_sP_p$; and expand $O_{(l\gg a)\gg b}$ by $\epsilon(l\gg a,b)$ followed by $O_b\epsilon(l,a)$. This asserts only structural composition coherence and contains no proper/open interchange or compactification comparison.

proof.text: Apply the three-fold open-extension coherence [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. Lift its equality through exact functors on derived categories. Naturality in both factors and associativity of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso identify this lifted equality with the two epsilon contraction paths, including the scheme-associativity transport.

proof.text: Unfold the specified rightDerivedLowerStarComp as the conjugate of the derived exact-pullback composition. Lift upperStarComp_assoc through exact functors using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_assoc and naturality in both factors. Apply conjugateEquiv_comp, conjugateEquiv_whiskerLeft, conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight and conjugateEquiv_associator_hom to obtain the equality of the two kappa contraction paths, including the scheme-associativity transport. This is a calculation with the existing exact-derived and adjunction interfaces, without any K-injective resolutions.

proof.text: Move epsilon maps through the natural kappa transformations. Cancel the two kappa contractions against their inverses using the preceding associativity, and then cancel the open contractions against the expansions using the first step. Functoriality, inverse identities and composition associativity give the identity. No properness or finiteness assumption is needed.

theorem derivedCompactSupportComposition_cancel
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X U V Xbar Ybar Zbar T : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : X ⟶ U) (a : U ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ Xbar)
    (p : Xbar ⟶ Ybar) (s : Ybar ⟶ Zbar) (t : Zbar ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion l] [IsOpenImmersion a] [IsOpenImmersion b]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) s t).hom.app
        (R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
          (D((b)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
            (D((a)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
              (D((l)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)))) ≫
      R((s ≫ t)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        (R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
          ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
              (openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a b) ≪≫
            Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).inv.app
              (D((l)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K))) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p (s ≫ t)).hom.app
        (D((a ≫ b)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj
          (D((l)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).obj K)) ≫
      R((p ≫ s ≫ t)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
            (openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) l (a ≫ b)) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).inv.app K) ≫
      eqToHom (by simp only [Category.assoc]) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (p ≫ s) t).inv.app _ ≫
      R((t)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p s).inv.app _) ≫
      R((t)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
        (R((s)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
          (R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
            ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
                (openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (l ≫ a) b) ≪≫
              Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom.app K ≫
              D((b)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]).map
                ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
                    (openImmersionLowerShriekComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) l a) ≪≫
                  Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).hom.app K)))) = 𝟙 _
